title: 15 everyday workflow UI fixes
eyebrow: Wisconsin Creative · Dashboard, Items, Bookings and Search
lede: Safer everyday search, dependable dashboard saved views, and clearer item and booking filters.

sections.heading: Matched component comparisons
sections.note: Original dirty source snapshots and final components rendered with identical fixture layout, shared compiled CSS, viewport, data, clock and appearance. No live records are involved. These prove component behavior, not authenticated route or production behavior.

pairs.title: Everyday filters
pairs.beforeCap: Open heading conflicts with the Overdue filter; active Sport control is absent.
pairs.afterCap: Heading says Overdue and the active Sport filter remains editable.

pairs.title: Dashboard location filters
pairs.beforeCap: The long location label escapes the popover.
pairs.afterCap: The location wraps inside the menu.

pairs.title: Item categories
pairs.beforeCap: Compact rows and ambiguous duplicate-label identities.
pairs.afterCap: 40px rows with stable option IDs and explicit inclusion names.

changes.was: Source-confirmed interaction, recovery or accessibility gap.

changes.was: Source-confirmed interaction, recovery or accessibility gap.
changes.now: Enter commits search without submitting an enclosing form.

verification: TypeScript, lint, production app build, docs/codemap and diff checks passed.
Duplicate item labels select independently and remain searchable
Item selection announced; rows >=40px and search labelled
Bookings special-filter heading and active Sport recovery
Enter commits once without submitting enclosing form
Read-only search resists clear and Escape
Storage failure preserves Save view and shows inline error
Saved views still save and delete successfully
Long dashboard labels fit phone width
notes: Local and uncommitted. No live records, permissions, custody rules, API contracts or production settings changed.
Browser evidence uses isolated real components; no signed-in application session was established, so authenticated full-route and deployment verification remain open.
Shared search propagation: Items, Bookings, Kits, global Search, Labels, Resources. Schedule was inspected as a candidate but is not changed by this batch.
Supplemental after-only images: after-storage-error.png and after-mobile.png in this directory.
